claims.text: 'In 2011 the DHS Under Secretary for Science and Technology (S&T) established KONA BLUE as a PSAP'; the DHS Deputy Secretary disapproved and terminated it approximately six months later, and it was 'never approved or formally established'.
AARO published the Kona Blue package on aaro.mil; the documents were made public in June 2024.

claims.text: Kona Blue was a DHS prospective special access program terminated on 10 February 2012; DHS declassified the associated documents and transmitted them to the Deputy Secretary of Defense on 5 February 2024.
